solutionStrategy: Match the social problem, an accidental hurt, with an apology followed by care for the person.
solutionSteps: Identify what happened: you caused accidental discomfort.
Reject congratulations, shopping, and unrelated time phrases.
Choose A because it repairs the interaction politely.
